data.one_liner: A widget to display a child after a delay with fading and sliding animations.
data.what_it_does: The DelayedDisplay widget allows developers to show any child widget after a specified delay. It automatically handles fading and sliding entrance animations, with customizable duration, curves, and offsets.
use_when: You want to stagger the entrance of multiple widgets on screen with a delay.
You need a simple fade and slide animation without managing AnimationControllers manually.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based or gesture-driven custom animations.
You require state management or routing capabilities.
strengths: Easy to use with minimal boilerplate
Customizable delay, fading duration, sliding curve, and begin offset
weaknesses: Limited to fade and slide animations only
data.minimal_example:
DelayedDisplay(
  delay: Duration(seconds: 1),
  child: Text(
    "Hello",
    style: TextStyle(
      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
      fontSize: 35.0,
      color: Colors.white,
    ),
  ),
)
